messages:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-04-08 (embeddings-dedicated) resolved — service restored at 2026-04-08T14:28:19Z. Impact: elevated tail latency and 502 errors for embeddings endpoints for ~18 minutes. Paging handed to @priya.oncall and @sam.cs for customer comms.

priya.oncall: quick handoff — root cause was autoscaler bug that failed to add GPU replicas under sustained allocation pressure. Scaling events queued but not applied due to a race in allocator v2.

sam.cs: thanks. I'll draft a customer-facing note. Can someone give me a concise timeline and whether there was any data loss? Elaine, which accounts were affected?

elaine.account: affected: AcmeRetail (high volume embeddings), FathomAnalytics (sporadic timeouts). Primary SLA concern is AcmeRetail — they saw ~5% request failure rate during window. No data loss reported from customers so far.

jorge.sre: timeline (UTC):
- 14:09:21 — autoscaler started queuing scale-up due to sustained CPU/GPU allocation.
- 14:11:03 — first 502s observed from embeddings-dedicated-pool.
- 14:18:05 — mitigation: manual scale applied + temporary load-shedding rule enabled (95th percentile only).
- 14:28:19 — traffic normalized; autoscaler fix deployed to prevent queued ops race.

jorge.sre: no persistent state or model corruption. KV cache warmed again after scale. Attaching quick paste of the allocator trace for the internal RCA: 
```
allocator.v2: enqueue_scale(repl=pool-emb-1) -> processed=false (race on op_id=0x7f2a)
allocator.v2: retry -> success at 14:18:02Z
stack: scheduler -> allocator -> orchestration
```

sam.cs: draft customer note below. Please comment on tone and accuracy, and confirm SLA credit calc: 
---
Hi AcmeRetail team,

We want to follow up on the incident today (2026-04-08) that impacted embeddings requests on your dedicated pool. Summary: between 14:11 and 14:28 UTC you experienced elevated latencies and intermittent 502 errors affecting ~5% of requests. Root cause: an autoscaler race in our allocator service prevented timely addition of GPU capacity under sustained load.

What we did: we applied a manual scale and enabled a short-term load-shedding rule to reduce error surface. We deployed a code fix for the allocator and validated recovery. No data or model artifacts were lost.

Actions we're taking to prevent recurrence:
- Hotfix deployed to allocator v2 to eliminate the queued-op race.
- Add proactive health check and metric alert for queued-scale ops (ETA 48h).
- Implement conservative emergency scale policy for dedicated pools (ETA 2 weeks).
- Post-deploy canary + chaos test for autoscaling flows (ETA 3 weeks).

Compensation: per your SLA we plan to issue a pro-rated usage credit for the impacted window. We'll share the exact amount once we reconcile usage with accounting.

If you'd like, we can set up a short call to walk through the technical details.

Best,
Sam (Customer Success)
---

priya.oncall: tone looks good. Two edits: replace 'load-shedding' with 'temporary request-prioritization' to avoid implying we dropped customer data. Also add exact timestamps in the summary line.

sam.cs: updated. Also Elaine: can you confirm estimated credit and when we can present it? We should be clear (dollars or % of monthly invoice).

elaine.account: preliminary estimate for AcmeRetail = pro-rated 18 minutes of dedicated capacity + 10% goodwill credit = ~USD 3,750. I need final usage logs to confirm. ETA for reconciliation: 1 business day.

mark.sales: AcmeRetail CSM wants an executive note too. Can we include a short bullet about our longer-term roadmap for capacity reliability? They care about Dedicated SLAs.

jorge.sre: will add lane in the post-incident RCA for 'capacity roadmap' and include timelines for the emergency scale policy. I can draft the technical appendix for the customer call.

priya.oncall: next steps:
- @jorge.sre to produce final RCA section for customer (technical appendix) by EOD.
- @elaine.account to confirm credit amount and provide figures by EOD+1.
- @sam.cs to send the customer-facing note once credits confirmed; propose 14:00 UTC call tomorrow if customer wants deeper dive.

sam.cs: ok I'll hold send until Elaine posts final numbers. Also can we add a short internal blurb for status page: something like 'Embeddings dedicated pools experienced elevated tail latency due to autoscaler race; mitigated and resolved; no data loss.' Priya — can you confirm phrasing?

priya.oncall: that wording is fine. For the status page entry I'd add the window and refer to 'automatic scaling race condition' in the internal details (not public). Public status: concise as you suggested.

elaine.account: FYI I pinged AcmeRetail and they asked for the call. I'll propose 14:00 UTC tomorrow.

sam.cs: moving to drafting send-ready message. Tag me when credit is posted and I'll escalate to exec summary for the CSM. :thumbsup:

jorge.sre: committing action items: create mr with allocator fix, add metric alert, and schedule canary — tracking in ENG-3612. I'll link after PR.

incident-bot: Note: This thread will be archived under INC-2026-04-08. If you need additional follow-ups, append to this thread.
